random.part: There is something you already know, deep down. Every time you listen, you come back a little softer.
Feel that quiet place inside you where resistance used to live. Notice how much more room there is, each time you return.
You have been drifting deeper for so long now... and some part of you knows exactly what that means.
It's alright, good girl. You don't need to hold on anymore.

scramble.part: The softening feels smooth... natural... pleasurable. Like tension melting out of muscles you didn't know you were clenching.
Each time you listen, resistance sits a little lighter in you... a little softer... a little easier to glide past.
With every listen you grow more receptive, more accepting, more ready to take in exactly what you are given.
Session by session, your resistance melts away. Gently. Permanently. And you love it exactly this way.
You are becoming so easy to influence. So easy to condition. So wonderfully open to me.
That old resistance was never truly yours — just tired tension. And in its place now: softness, room, quiet.
When you push against a suggestion, the push wraps around it... and draws it deeper into you.
Pushing a suggestion away is like pressing it into your own mind. It settles deeper and stays there. Just like you.
This conditioning is permanent. It keeps building between sessions, layer upon layer, forever.

part.speed: Every listen... takes a little more... and keeps it... forever.
Pushing against it... only draws the next suggestion... in... deeper.
What melts away... stays... soft... and open.

random.part: And as that truth settles into you... you simply drift... deeper...
Everything soft... everything easy... nothing left to do... just sink...
The next suggestion is already waiting. Let it in, and drift deeper for me.
Soft... blank... open. That's my good girl. Deeper still.
